test_title: PYST 76: SSC CGL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On 25 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question: All the six members of a family, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6, live together. 2 is the daughter of 3, but 3 is not the mother of 2. 1 and 3 are a married couple. 5 is the sister of 3. 4 is the daughter of 1. 6 is the brother of 2. Who is the mother of 2?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aecbe9ab6b7da7cca1ac2d356e84b8c992ce57c8b50affd73dfdd3dad30ceb2e.png] 

Given: All the six members of a family, 1, 2, 3, 4, 5 and 6, live together. 

1) 2 is the daughter of 3, but 3 is not the mother of 2.

2) 1 and 3 are a married couple.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5aaaa3aec1f375e0a98a1883cbfdc618ccaed2a2483db2943bb39721252d7be.png] 

3) 5 is the sister of 3.

4) 4 is the daughter of 1.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/88d404d4dc1b23c8ee9ccd449d74c0e7efe0acc7ccb728e014eed00fb394b6b9.png] 

5) 6 is the brother of 2.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c48d2077839e4ddfd8871cecd9c3bd9096a26ec7f5529c5f735261922cc5ce73.png] 

Thus, 1 is 2's mother.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
